name: Ozzie Togglevolt
summary: In Kharanos, Ozzie Togglevolt works to find a cure for the leper gnomes of Gnomeregan. He and Razzle Sprysprocket continue their research among the snowy hills of Dun Morogh.

sections.title: Escape from the Deep
sections.body: Ozzie Togglevolt was deep inside Gnomeregan when catastrophe struck. As toxic fallout filled the corridors to stem the trogg invasion, he stood beside Gnoarn. A sudden radioactive discharge hit Gnoarn, changing him forever before Ozzie's eyes. Ozzie escaped to the surface and reached Dun Morogh alive, but the disaster stayed with him.

sections.title: The Kharanos Workshop
sections.body: In Kharanos, Ozzie spends his days tinkering with Razzle Sprysprocket. Their work is personal: they seek a way to reverse the mutagenic fallout from their lost home and cure the suffering leper gnomes.

faq.answer: Ozzie Togglevolt is a gnome engineer in Kharanos, Dun Morogh. He escaped the radioactive devastation of Gnomeregan and now uses his skills to seek a cure for his afflicted kin.

faq.q: What is Ozzie trying to cure?
faq.answer: Ozzie and Razzle Sprysprocket are researching a way to cleanse the toxic irradiation that turned many of their kin into leper gnomes stricken with madness.
Gnoarn was beside Ozzie in Gnomeregan when the toxic vents were unleashed. Ozzie saw a radioactive bolt strike Gnoarn, driving his determination to reverse the contamination.

faq.q: Who is working with Ozzie in Kharanos?
faq.answer: Ozzie works with Razzle Sprysprocket in Kharanos. Together, they tinker, develop concoctions, and gather contaminated field specimens to study the radioactive fallout.
Ozzie asks travelers in Dun Morogh to gather irradiated residues and components from around Gnomeregan through 'The Day After', 'Gnogaine', and 'The Only Cure is More Green Glow'.

angles.text: For gnome adventurers, Ozzie embodies the grief and resolve of Gnomeregan's survivors. He refuses to abandon his irradiated kin to their fate.
For an engineer, Ozzie's work shows the trial and error of gnome craft: devices can backfire in combat or lead to breakthroughs in biochemical decontamination.
As an Alliance traveler, you can find Ozzie in Kharanos, just outside Ironforge. He aids travelers while the Alliance holds its foothold in Dun Morogh's frigid hills.
